title: Papacy Versus Empire
dek: Of how popes and emperors made each other, then fought for three centuries over who stood higher, and how kings won.

panels.label: As Each Side Told It
panels.text: Popes claimed that Christ gave Peter's heirs authority over kings; emperors claimed their crown came from God directly, not through Rome.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: Both claims were weapons in fights over land, revenue and the right to appoint bishops. The winners were the national monarchies that neither side…
